name: s102-conventional-commit-allows-heredoc-goodmsg

tool_input.command:
git add src/search.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(search): add the search endpoint

Handles "quoted" terms, (parens), 'apostrophes' and `backticks`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

notes: Guard for s101: quotes, parentheses and backticks inside the heredoc body are literal text, so a conventional subject passes.
